name: kai
description: Local agent that integrates with LM Studio local LLM API for chat and code tasks.

commands.title: Kai: Send Code Selection to Chat

kai.serverUrl.description: The base URL for your LM Studio local server API.

kai.lmStudioCacheDir.description: Custom directory path for LM Studio model cache (auto-detects ~/.cache/lm-studio or ~/.lmstudio when empty).

kai.apiKey.description: The API key for Google Gemini models.

kai.mistralApiKey.description: API key for Mistral AI free tier (console.mistral.ai).

kai.cohereApiKey.description: API key for Cohere free tier (dashboard.cohere.com).

kai.cerebrasApiKey.description: API key for Cerebras free tier (cloud.cerebras.ai).

kai.zhipuApiKey.description: API key for Zhipu AI (GLM) free tier (open.bigmodel.cn).

kai.omnirouteServerUrl.description: Base URL for your OmniRoute AI gateway instance (run locally via npm: npx omniroute).

kai.omnirouteApiKey.description: API key for OmniRoute AI gateway (if API key authentication is enabled).

kai.temperature.description: Temperature parameter for chat completions (0.0 to 2.0).

kai.webSearchMcpPath.description: Optional custom path to the Web Search MCP server index.js (relative to workspace or absolute). If empty, auto-detects bundled web-search-mcp.

kai.language.description: Language for Kai Agent UI and response messages.
